think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and intended meaning in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether the knob has documented sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch it into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/ignore). 3) Verify whether any such value breaks the normal numeric ordering semantics (i.e., the knob stops behaving like a regular cost parameter). 4) If no sentinel values exist and all valid values simply scale the same concept (here: planner cost), classify it as not special.
